title: We asked ourselves: What if you could ONLY play a game through ChatGPT? And then we made that game :)
author: TheZilk
selftext:
We had an idea, since everything is AI these days how about playing a game through the use of AI. So in AI Says you guide a radio controlled human through a set of deadly test chambers using our version of ChatGPT, so basically a prompt terminal where you input commands.

The catch being that the AI is blind, you have to be it's eyes and tell it how to move the human. And if you are vague it WILL result in the human dying.

We are launching November 3 and hope everyone finds it as fun and absurd as we do :)
